cond_0001.intro:
We are looking for a VP of Finance to join our team. The VP of Finance will be the head of finance and reports directly to the CEO. They will initially oversee one direct report, an Accounting Manager, and a team of three to four accountants. The candidate will own all aspects of the finance function, including month end close, annual audit, financial planning and analysis, and will be an integral member of strategic finance initiatives.
The initial key objectives are to help build out from scratch and maintain the following:
Reporting Package – analyze monthly financial performance (actuals to budget to forecast) and offer MD&A to the executive team in PPT format
Model & Seasonality Model – Builds revenue by customer segment by month for forecasting and reporting needs
Budget – Work collaboratively with department heads to design and implement a best-in-class annual budget process
Forecasting - periodic forecasting of revenue, costs, and headcounts
Statement Model – constructs all 3 statements from the Trial Balance
Ad hoc models/reports as needed (ex: build a profitability model for a new product launch)
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Head of Finance - oversee the finance function
Serve the organization as a subject matter expert in Consumer Packaged Goods industry
Serve as a business partner to the leadership team of the Company by owning the financial strategy, planning and projection, including the financial model and KPIs of the business
Lead the month-end close process and first GAAP audit
Design, implement, and maintain the Monthly Reporting Package, which will include key financial and operating metrics
Design, implement, and maintain the 3 statement model
Design, implement, and maintain the Revenue and product profitability models
Design, implement, and maintain the annual Annual Budget and hold monthly budget variance meetings with key stakeholders
Work closely with leadership and marketing to identify, design, implement and maintain periodic (daily, weekly, monthly, etc.) KPIs
Automate and optimize the financial reporting processes by leveraging technology
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum of ten-fifteen years of progressive financial planning and analysis experience
Minimum of two years experience in a DTC food and beverage Consumer Packaged Goods (""CPG"") manufacturing company
Experience owning the entire financial statement preparation process (income statement and balance sheet)
Able to build complex financial models
Experience implementing and maintaining monthly reporting packages
Possess above-average skills in Excel (sumifs, pivots, xlookup, index match, etc.) and experience working with large data sets and multifaceted spreadsheets
Excellent communication, writing, and relationship-building skills
Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance or Equivalent
Preferred Requirements
Two years of experience working with [Product name masked]
Two years of experience working with Power BI
Two years experience with CRMs
Experience supporting the sales and marketing function by identifying and producing key KPIs (CAC) and calculating compensation plans. Using business intelligence (""BI"") tools, and disciplined data sets to achieve the former

This role is the head of finance and reports directly to the CEO. You will work alongside an Accounting Manager and a team of three to four accountants. The finance function is in transition, and there are several urgent priorities to work through together with the team.
The initial shared objectives include building out and maintaining the following:
Reporting Package – analyze monthly financial performance (actuals to budget to forecast) and contribute MD&A to the executive team in PPT format
Model & Seasonality Model – build revenue by customer segment by month for forecasting and reporting needs
Budget – work collaboratively with department heads to design and implement a best-in-class annual budget process
Forecasting – periodic forecasting of revenue, costs, and headcounts
Statement Model – construct all 3 statements from the Trial Balance
Ad hoc models/reports as needed (e.g., build a profitability model for a new product launch)
cond_0207.responsibilities:
Coordinate the finance function as head of finance
Serve the organization as a subject matter expert in the Consumer Packaged Goods industry
Partner with the leadership team on financial strategy, planning, and projection, including the financial model and KPIs of the business
Coordinate the month-end close process and first GAAP audit
Work with stakeholders to design, implement, and maintain the Monthly Reporting Package, including key financial and operating metrics
Design, implement, and maintain the 3-statement model
Design, implement, and maintain the revenue and product profitability models
Collaborate with department heads to design, implement, and maintain the annual budget, and hold monthly budget variance meetings with key stakeholders
Work closely with leadership and marketing to identify, design, implement, and maintain periodic (daily, weekly, monthly) KPIs
Help automate and optimize financial reporting processes by leveraging technology
cond_0207.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, or equivalent
Minimum of ten to fifteen years of progressive financial planning and analysis experience
Minimum of two years of experience in a DTC food and beverage Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) manufacturing company
Experience owning the entire financial statement preparation process (income statement and balance sheet)
Able to build complex financial models
Two years of experience working with [Product name masked]
Two years of experience working with Power BI
Two years of experience with CRMs
Experience implementing and maintaining monthly reporting packages
Experience supporting the sales and marketing function by identifying and producing key KPIs (CAC) and calculating compensation plans, using BI tools and disciplined data sets
Above-average skills in Excel (sumifs, pivots, xlookup, index match, etc.) and experience working with large data sets and multifaceted spreadsheets
Excellent communication, writing, and relationship-building skills
Preferred Requirements
Best-in-class experience in a recognized firm (e.g., public accounting or consulting), a Fortune-recognized company, or experience working with institutional investors (PE-backed companies)
E-commerce/SaaS experience
Python/R or other programming language
CFA, CPA, or advanced degree
cond_0207.values: We value having a positive impact on the people our work affects. We aim to act with responsibility, fairness, and respect in the way we make decisions and deliver our work.

[Company name masked] is looking for a VP of Finance for a privately held Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) food and beverage manufacturing e-commerce Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) company.
This opportunity suits a finance professional who is ready to work within a finance function that is in transition and will require several urgent matters to be addressed. The team is looking for someone focused on career growth who understands the value of helping build out a best-in-class finance function and tech stack, and is willing to put in the work required to get there.
The VP of Finance reports directly to the CEO and will work alongside one direct report, an Accounting Manager, and a team of three to four accountants. The role involves coordinating across all aspects of the finance function, including month-end close, annual audit, and financial planning and analysis, and contributing to strategic finance initiatives.
The initial key objectives are to help build out from scratch and maintain the following:
Reporting Package – analyze monthly financial performance (actuals to budget to forecast) and share MD&A with the executive team in PPT format
Model & Seasonality Model – builds revenue by customer segment by month for forecasting and reporting needs
Budget – work collaboratively with department heads to design and implement a best-in-class annual budget process
Forecasting – periodic forecasting of revenue, costs, and headcounts
Statement Model – constructs all 3 statements from the Trial Balance
Ad hoc models/reports as needed (e.g., build a profitability model for a new product launch)
cond_0450.responsibilities:
Coordinate the finance function as Head of Finance
Support the organization as a subject matter expert in the Consumer Packaged Goods industry
Partner with the leadership team on financial strategy, planning, and projection, including the financial model and KPIs of the business
Coordinate the month-end close process and first GAAP audit
Work with stakeholders to design, implement, and maintain the Monthly Reporting Package, including key financial and operating metrics
Design, implement, and maintain the 3-statement model
Design, implement, and maintain the revenue and product profitability models
Collaborate with department heads to design, implement, and maintain the annual budget, and facilitate monthly budget variance meetings with key stakeholders
Work closely with leadership and marketing to identify, design, implement, and maintain periodic (daily, weekly, monthly, etc.) KPIs
Help automate and optimize financial reporting processes by working with the team to leverage available technology
cond_0450.requirements:
Minimum of two years of experience in a DTC food and beverage Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) manufacturing company
Minimum of ten to fifteen years of progressive financial planning and analysis experience
Experience owning the entire financial statement preparation process (income statement and balance sheet)
Able to build complex financial models
Two years of experience working with [Product name masked]
Two years of experience working with Power BI
Two years of experience with CRMs
Experience implementing and maintaining monthly reporting packages
Experience supporting the sales and marketing function by identifying and producing key KPIs (CAC) and calculating compensation plans, using business intelligence (BI) tools and disciplined data sets
Best-in-class experience in a recognized firm (e.g., public accounting or consulting) or Fortune recognized Company
Above-average skills in Excel (sumifs, pivots, xlookup, index match, etc.) and experience working with large data sets and multifaceted spreadsheets
Excellent communication, writing, and relationship-building skills
E-commerce/SaaS experience
Python/R or other programming language
Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, or equivalent
CFA, CPA, or advanced degree is preferred

This opportunity is for a confident, driven finance professional who can keep pace in a finance function that is in transition and will require several urgent matters to be addressed. The team needs individuals focused on career growth who understand the value of being part of a team that built out a best-in-class finance function and tech stack, and who are willing to put in the work required to achieve that mission.
The VP of Finance will be the head of finance, reporting directly to the CEO. They will initially oversee one direct report, an Accounting Manager, and a team of three to four accountants. The candidate will own all aspects of the finance function, including month-end close, annual audit, financial planning and analysis, and will be an active member of strategic finance initiatives.
The initial key objectives are to help build out from scratch and maintain the following:
Reporting Package – analyze monthly financial performance (actuals to budget to forecast) and communicate MD&A to the executive team in PPT format
Model & Seasonality Model – builds revenue by customer segment by month for forecasting and reporting needs
Budget – work collaboratively with department heads to design and implement a best-in-class annual budget process
Forecasting – periodic forecasting of revenue, costs, and headcounts
Statement Model – constructs all 3 statements from the Trial Balance
Ad hoc models/reports as needed (e.g., build a profitability model for a new product launch)
cond_0483.responsibilities:
Head of Finance – oversee the finance function
Serve the organization as a subject matter expert in the Consumer Packaged Goods industry
Serve as a business partner to the leadership team by owning the financial strategy, planning and projection, including the financial model and KPIs of the business; regularly connect with leaders to clarify priorities and walk them through financial trade-offs
Lead the month-end close process and first GAAP audit
Design, implement, and maintain the Monthly Reporting Package, which will include key financial and operating metrics
Design, implement, and maintain the 3-statement model
Design, implement, and maintain the Revenue and product profitability models
Design, implement, and maintain the annual Budget and hold monthly budget variance meetings with key stakeholders
Work closely with leadership and marketing on a regular basis to identify, design, implement, and maintain periodic (daily, weekly, monthly, etc.) KPIs
Automate and optimize financial reporting processes by leveraging technology
cond_0483.requirements:
Minimum of two years of experience in a DTC food and beverage Consumer Packaged Goods (""CPG"") manufacturing company
Minimum of ten to fifteen years of progressive financial planning and analysis experience
Experience owning the entire financial statement preparation process (income statement and balance sheet)
Able to build complex financial models
Two years of experience working with [Product name masked]
Two years of experience working with Power BI
Two years of experience with CRMs
Experience implementing and maintaining monthly reporting packages
Experience supporting the sales and marketing function by identifying and producing key KPIs (CAC) and calculating compensation plans; using business intelligence (""BI"") tools and disciplined data sets to achieve the former
Best-in-class experience in a recognized firm (e.g., public accounting or consulting) or Fortune recognized Company
Possess above-average skills in Excel (sumifs, pivots, xlookup, index match, etc.) and experience working with large data sets and multifaceted spreadsheets
Excellent communication, writing, and relationship-building skills
E-commerce/SaaS experience
Python/R or other programming language
Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, or Equivalent
CFA, CPA, or advanced degree is preferred
